description: Targeted NETWORK mappings for a campaign (target_type = 'NETWORK', not deleted), reachable by either key. Filter `campaign_id` when you hold the marketing_campaign_id -- it resolves through campaign_tagging_data. Filter `internal_campaign_id` when you hold the internal numeric campaign_id and want to query the targeting table directly. The join to campaign_tagging_data is a LEFT JOIN, so rows with no tagging record still return under internal_campaign_id. resolved_campaign_id is the same value as internal_campaign_id, kept under the name the retired via-CTD report used.

campaign_id.description: The resolving marketing_campaign_id the caller holds (a non-campaign_id key). Mandatory filter: pass the marketing_campaign_id here; campaign_tagging_data resolves it to the internal campaign_id(s) whose network targeting is returned.

internal_campaign_id.description: Internal numeric campaign_id on the targeting table, as a string. Filter this when you do not hold a marketing_campaign_id.

resolved_campaign_id.description: Internal numeric campaign_id that the supplied marketing_campaign_id resolved to (via campaign_tagging_data), and to which this network targeting mapping belongs.

target_details.description: The targeted NETWORK definition for this campaign, serialized as a JSON string (TO_JSON_STRING of the target_details struct).

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0. Row-level dimension passthrough (network targeting lookup) with no aggregated measure; KAM requires at least one metric to fetch.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_db_campaign_targeting_mapping` AS ctm LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON SAFE_CAST(ctd.campaign_id AS INT64) = ctm.campaign_id AND SAFE_CAST(ctd.client_id AS INT64) = ctm.client_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS cl ON SAFE_CAST(cl.client_id AS INT64) = ctm.client_id AND cl.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' WHERE ctm.target_type = 'NETWORK' AND ctm.is_deleted = 0 AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
